newsitem.title: USA: Ladbroke says court okays club acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke says court okays club acquisition.

text.p: Ladbroke Racing Corp on Wednesday said a federal judge had approved its acquisition of a controlling interesting in the Bicycle club casino in Bell Gardens, a suburb of Los Angeles.

Ladbroke Racing, a unit international gambling concern Ladbroke Plc which is based in London, can now move forward with its plan to acquire a controlling stake in the card club, it said in a statement.

The Bicycle Club is California's second largest gambling facility. The government seized ownership in 1990 as part of a drug trafficking case, and its acquisition had been subject to approval by U.S. District Court in southern Florida.

"The court's approval of our plan ends one chapter of the Bicycle Club story," John Long, president of Ladbroke/USA, said in a statement. "All of us associated with the club can now look forward to the remodeling of the facility and the company's goal of making it, once again, the premier card club casino."
California law effectively bars a publicly traded company from operating gambling facilities they own. Ladbroke said it has a short list of operators it is now reviewing.
